note: Technical checks only. A pass is not visual or narrative approval.

checks.name: M1 UI art, actions, items, design and lab are unchanged since M2 began, apart from the owner's recorded edits

no duplicate candidate PNGs remain beside the production files

no uncommitted change to M1 art, design, lab or the reception production art
exactly the ten edited cards and three font atlases record an owner edit

the other 16 package sprites are byte-identical to the M2 start

only the fitted glyph boxes (a c e l r v w x [ ]) changed, same characters and advances
shell SHA-256 unchanged

approved atlas matches its manifest hash

route validation passes
the slice stylesheet has no :hover rule

page loads ready

portrait aperture is the committed 564x278 rectangle and clips its content
portrait layers, in order: background -> rear/mid FX -> NPC -> foreground FX (four separate elements, no canvas)
portrait background and NPC: 564x278 natural, displayed at exactly 1x (564x278) at the aperture origin, no transform/filter/opacity/transition
FX layers are present, empty and cover the aperture
stage order: scene, portrait, overlay, then the shell on top
every element id on the page is unique

the scene's 1 px right / 2 px bottom overflow is clipped by the aperture

the game ships no NPC toggle or debug control for the portrait layers
no errors while proving the art
card edit: each of the ten cards visibly changed
